The '''Askar Trace''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that ran through several [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] between the [[Leritor system/Legends|Leritor]] and [[Lannik system/Legends|Lannik systems]]. It was charted [[Millennium/Legends|thousands]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and changed hands multiple times throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history. Just before the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] used the route while traveling to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. In later years, the Askar Trace was the site of multiple battles during the [[Noolian Crisis]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Description==
[[File:AskarTraceWithSectors.jpg|thumb|left|175px|The Askar Trace passed through six Mid Rim sectors.]]
The Askar Trace<ref name="Stay" /> was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that ran through [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] between the [[Leritor system/Legends|Leritor]] and [[Lannik system/Legends|Lannik systems]]<ref name="TEA" /> and once defined the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]] edge of [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]].<ref name="Stay" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Askar Trace ran through the [[Yucrales sector/Legends|Yucrales]], [[Likasha sector/Legends|Likasha]], [[Hertae sector/Legends|Hertae]], [[Tandon sector/Legends|Tandon]], [[Noolian sector/Legends|Noolian]], and [[Lannik Space/Legends|Lannik Space]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]],<ref name="Sector Map" /> and the Leritor, [[Nexus Ortai system/Legends|Nexus Ortai]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Galboron system/Legends|Galboron]],<ref name="TEGtW" /> [[Bresnia system/Legends|Bresnia]], [[Lanos system/Legends|Lanos]], [[Dressel system/Legends|Dressel]], and Lannik [[Star system/Legends|systems]] were all situated along the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route.<ref name="TEA" />

The hyperlane, which intersected with the [[Reena Trade Route]] near the Nexus Ortai<ref name="TEA" /> and Galbaron systems<ref name="TEGtW" /> and the [[Bothan Run/Legends|Bothan Run]] at the Lannik system,<ref name="TEA" /> shared its name with [[clan Askar]], the group of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] that discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]] [[200 BBY/Legends|two hundred]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Stay" /> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the average population of the systems located between the Nexus Ortai and Lannik systems numbered between five hundred million and one billion, although the Nexus Ortai and the Dressel were both home from one to ten billion. The systems between Lerritor and Nexus Ortai meanwhile averaged a population of between one hundred and five hundred million.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
===Early history and Clone Wars===
The area in which the Askar Trace would eventually be located was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]. The route was founded sometime after [[3996 BBY]] but before the [[Mandalorian Wars]], which lasted from [[3976 BBY]] to [[3960 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]],<ref name="1032 BBY">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}} is presented as an [[in-universe]] [[Astrography|cartographical]] survey and field report compiled shortly before the [[Raid on Oranessan|commencement]] of [[Operation Influx]], which {{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knighterrant_influx/index.html|text=''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx''|int=Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx}} dates to [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].</ref> the Askar Trace was situated outside of the [[Republic Security Cordon]], a line of demarcation that the Republic drew around the inner portions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and outside which it deactivated its network of [[Communications relay/Legends|hyperspace relays]].<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref> During the [[Light and Darkness War|final phase]] of the [[New Sith Wars]], from [[1004 BBY]] to [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the route largely fell inside the territory that was either contested by or unaligned with the Republic or its [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] enemies, though a portion of the hyperlane lay within firmly Sith-controlled territory.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:AskarTrace22BBY-EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|250px|During the Clone Wars, a portion of the Askar Trace fell within Separatist space.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Askar Trace was situated within the territory in which the Republic's [[Thirteenth Army]] was tasked with combating Separatist [[Confederacy military/Legends|forces]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], a section of the Trace extending from the Leritor system to beyond the Nexus Ortai system was located within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the Confederacy.<ref name="TEGtW" />

Following the acquisition of the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during the Clone Wars, a facility managed by [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]]<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref> displayed a [[Map/Legends|map]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that featured the Askar Trace.<ref name="AoI" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], just before the Clone Wars [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|ended]], the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] traveled aboard Organa's [[Sundered Heart/Legends|starship]] along the Askar Trace on their journey from the Mid Rim planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] world [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref name="TEA" />

===From Empire to Empire===
[[File:AskarTraceVong-TEA.png|thumb|left|175px|The Yuuzhan Vong advance along the Askar Trace]]
During the [[Noolian Crisis]], an [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]] segment of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]]&mdash;a conflict in which the newly-[[Declaration of a New Order|formed]] [[Galactic Empire]] asserted its control over [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] and other opponents in the outer regions of the galaxy&mdash;[[Aqualish]] forces attacked the Empire along the Askar Trace, taking [[Galboron]] and other worlds. Eventually, [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Par Lankin]] were able to defeat the Aqualish in the [[Battle of Galboron]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

From [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] to [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy, the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] launched attacks along the Askar Trace, capturing the [[Battle of the Lannik system (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Lannik]], [[Battle of the Dressel system|Dressel]] [[Battle of the Nexus Ortai system|Nexus Ortai]], and [[Battle of the Leritor system (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Leritor]] systems. All four systems remained under Yuuzhan Vong control until at least 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]. By [[137 ABY]], the entirety of the Askar Trace lay within the boundaries of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Askar Trace was first pictured in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" /> The hyperlane made its first proper appearance in ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="AoI announcement" /> It was first identified by name in the [[2014]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] sourcebook [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]] system.<ref name="Stay" />
